issues.description: The problem statement and the solution expect the StockIngredient.price to be an int (constructor signature StockIngredient(String, int, int) and UML shows -price: int), but the template implementation declares price as a double and uses a constructor/getter with double. This type mismatch across artifacts can confuse students about the expected type for ingredient prices and will cause inconsistencies when implementing SealSaloon methods that rely on integer prices.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the price field and related constructor/getter in the template's StockIngredient.java from double to int to match the UML and the solution. Specifically, declare 'private final int price;', update the constructor parameter to int price, and make getPrice() return int. Ensure all usages in the template code and tests expect int prices.
